_note: Page facts for `cc settings apply|verify` (src/adapters/claudeSettings.ts): claude.ai Projects and a project's instructions editor. Data, not code: when claude.ai changes, fix it HERE (a data-file edit, no code change). Every entry is { value, status }; status "verified" + `seen` = observed on the live page (read-only discovery by the setup session through cc's own openSession on the account's master, HELM host, 2026-11-03 8:45-8:51 AM CST); "unverified" = best knowledge, not yet seen. cc prints how many are still unverified on every run. Regex strings are case-insensitive and are matched against a control's accessible name (aria-label, else its visible text). Which controls cc may click at all is NOT decided here: CLAUDE.md rule 9 and the deny list in the adapter code bound it, so no edit of this file can widen it. There is deliberately NO 'auth' block: sign-in cookies are the claude platform's (claude.json). Seen but deliberately unused: /settings/profile and /settings/capabilities redirect to /new.

hosts.note: the only origin cc may read or click on; any other host stops the run

projectsUrl.note: heading Projects; buttons New project, Search projects, Sort projects

projectLink.note: each card is <a href=/project/<uuid>>; a pinned project appears as TWO anchors with the same href (pinned list + main list): cc dedupes by href

projectName.note: CSS selector of the name inside a card; empty = the first non-empty line of the card's text. The card's inner layout was not recorded; cc also refuses (never creates) when the name appears as any other line of a card, so a wrong guess here cannot produce a duplicate

projectHeading.note: a project page's h1 is the project name; cc checks it equals the declared name before reading or writing

protectedProjects.note: the starter project (it has no Edit instructions button); cc never opens or touches these, even if declared

createUrl.note: there is no create page: create is a dialog opened by createButton on the Projects list

createButton.note: button on the Projects list; opens a [role=dialog] titled Create a project

createDialog.note: heading Create a project; buttons Close, Add context, Cancel, Create project; Escape closes it; it has NO instructions field

createNameField.note: CSS inside createDialog; placeholder Name your project. cc types only the name (the description textarea is left empty)

createSubmit.note: inside createDialog; enabled with the name alone

instructionsOpen.note: button on the project page (other buttons there: Rename <name>, More options for <name>, Search this project, Pin/Unpin project, Add files, View memory, Add scheduled task: never clicked)

instructionsField.note: the single textarea in the dialog (aria-label Set project instructions); fill() of 3873 characters works

instructionsSave.note: inside the dialog, next to Cancel; enabled once text is present

closeKey.note: closes the dialog without saving after a read (no button is clicked for that)

signedOutMarkers.note: copied from claude.json / claude-code.json; the account was signed in during discovery, so this was not seen

humanCheck.note: copied from claude-code.json (seen for claude.ai/code on 2026-10-17); no human check appeared during this discovery

timing.note: seen: 3500 ms after goto is enough; a save shows on a reload ~3 s later. The other values are cc defaults (timeouts and list-stability checks); every poll is 500 ms or slower (CLAUDE.md rule 5)
